facts.value: ASU welcomes students from 157 countries around the world.
More than 15,100 students call ASU home.
ASU is the No. 1 public university chosen by international students.
At ASU, you’ll have access to a high-quality education, as well as research, entrepreneurial, and other valuable opportunities.
Students who are educated in the U.S. graduate with the necessary skills to enter a global career market and succeed in their future endeavors.
International students are encouraged to visit our international student admission page for undergraduate and graduate applications.
ASU looks at each student holistically, reviewing GPA, English proficiency, test scores, and overall experience.
ASU is the #1 public university in the U.S. for innovation, ahead of MIT and Stanford.
